name: Steward of Nature (Geomancer Archetype)
body:
Some geomancers eschew some of their magical versatility in favor of a greater focus on protecting and seeking guidance from nature. Such geomancers are called stewards of nature.

Nature Magic

A steward of nature’s spellcasting is fundamentally different from other geomancers. They cast spells like a sorcerer and treat the spells prepared table to determine their spells known. Their spell list for choosing is drawn from the druid spell list, along with any spell with spirit in the name, specifically affecting spirits, like protection from evil, and summon nature’s ally. However, the steward of nature may choose to temporarily replace one of their spells known for each level when communing with spirits as follows.

When communing with the spirits, a steward of nature chooses one spell for each spell level they know and “learn” it for the day. The spell must be from the spell list given for the element to which they are communing. For example, if a 5th-level steward of nature is communing with the spirit of wood, they could retain their known orisons, replace their produce flame known with entangle, and their hold animal known with eagle’s splendor. The next time they commune with spirits, the temporary spells revert back to their known spells. Stewards of nature still use Wisdom for their spellcasting ability score.

At each odd level after 1st, a steward of nature can choose to learn a new spell in place of one they already know. In effect, they lose the old spell in exchange for a new one. The new spell’s level must be the same as that of the spell being exchanged. A steward of nature may swap only a single spell at any given level, and must choose whether or not to swap the spell at the same time that they gain new spells known for the level.

This ability modifies spells.
